invariants.rationale: FileHandle is passed to getDependencyFileHandles and used to construct AssetDescriptor, so it must not be null.
The method likely expects the FileHandle to refer to an existing resource in order to find dependency files.
TextureLoader.TextureParameter is forwarded to AssetDescriptor, which may expect a non-null value.
The method seems to treat tmjFile as a file rather than a directory, passing it as-is to getDependencyFileHandles.
The dependency file likely must not be empty for successful tiled map loading.
